kebab_example: aliyun hologram create-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-h --vpc-id vpc-t4netc3y5xxxx --vswitch-id vsw-2vccsiymtxxxxxx --instance-name my_holo --instance-type Standard --charge-type PostPaid --api-version 2022-06-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInstance

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Default value: true. Valid values:
true: Automatic payment is enabled.
false: Only an order is generated, and no payment is made.
Default value: true. If your payment method has insufficient balance, you can set the AutoPay parameter to false. In this case, an unpaid order is generated, and you can log on to the Expenses and Costs console to complete the payment
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付，默认为true。取值：
true：自动支付。
false：只生成订单，不支付。
默认值为true。如果您的支付方式余额不足，可以将参数AutoPay设置为false，此时会生成未支付订单，您可以登录费用与成本自行支付
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable monthly auto-renewal. Default value: false. Valid values:
true: Enabled.
false: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启按月自动续费，默认值为false。取值：
true：开启。
false：不开启
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:
PrePaid: Subscription.
PostPaid: Pay-as-you-go.
This parameter is ignored for Shared instances. Shared is a defined specifications type, and its billing method defaults to PostPaid
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型。取值：
PrePaid：包年包月。
PostPaid: 按量付费。
Shared实例类型会忽略该参数。Shared是一种固定规格类型，收费类型默认为PostPaid
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The low-frequency storage capacity of the instance. Unit: GB.
This parameter is ignored for pay-as-you-go instances
parameters.help_zh:
实例低频存储空间。单位：GB。
按量付费（PostPaid）实例会忽略此参数
parameters.name: cold_storage_size

parameters.help_en:
The instance specifications. Valid values:
32 cores, 128 GB (Number of compute nodes: 2)
64 cores, 256 GB (Number of compute nodes: 4)
96 cores, 384 GB (Number of compute nodes: 6)
128 cores, 512 GB (Number of compute nodes: 8)
Other specifications


Specify the number of cores.
To purchase an instance with more than 1,024 cores, submit a ticket.
You do not need to specify the specifications for a Shared instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格。取值：
32核128 GB（计算节点数量：2）
64核256 GB（计算节点数量：4）
96核384 GB（计算节点数量：6）
128核512 GB（计算节点数量：8）
等


填写核数即可。
购买1024以上规格实例请提交工单申请。
Shared实例类型无需指定规格
parameters.name: cpu

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration. For example, set this parameter to 2 for a two-month subscription.
This parameter is not required if the billing method is PostPaid
parameters.help_zh:
购买周期。比如购买2个月。
若付费类型为PostPaid，则无需指定
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable Serverless Computing
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启ServerlessComputing
parameters.name: enable_serverless_computing

parameters.help_en:
The number of gateways. Valid values: 2 to 50.

This parameter is required only for Warehouse instances
parameters.help_zh:
网关数量，取值[2, 50]。

只有Warehouse类型需要指定该参数
parameters.name: gateway_count

parameters.help_en: The initial databases
parameters.help_zh: 初始数据库
parameters.name: initial_databases

parameters.help_en: The name of the instance. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length. Each Chinese character or letter counts as one character
parameters.help_zh: 实例名称(2-64个字符，一个中文/字母算一个字符)
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. Valid values:
Standard: General-purpose.
Follower: Read-only secondary instance.
Warehouse: Compute group.
Shared: Shared.
Severless: Serverless
parameters.help_zh:
实例类型。取值：
Standard：通用型。
Follower：只读从实例。
Warehouse：计算组型。
Shared：共享型。
Severless：Serverless型
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the primary instance. This parameter is required for Follower instances.

The primary and secondary instances must meet the following conditions:
The primary instance is in the Running state.
The primary and secondary instances are in the same region.
The primary and secondary instances are in the same zone.
The primary instance is associated with fewer than 10 secondary instances.
The primary and secondary instances belong to the same Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
主实例Id，Follower类型必填。

主从实例必须满足以下条件：
主实例"运行正常"(Running)状态
主从实例regionId一致
主从实例zoneId一致
主实例已绑定的从实例数少于10个
主从实例属于同一个主账号
parameters.name: leader_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle. Valid values:
Month: Monthly billing.
Hour: Hourly billing.

PrePaid supports only Month.
PostPaid supports only Hour.
For Shared instances, this parameter is automatically set to Hour and does not need to be specified
parameters.help_zh:
计费周期。取值：
Month：按月计费。
Hour：按小时计费。

PrePaid 只支持Month
PostPaid 只支持Hour
Shared类型自动设为Hour，无需指定
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en:
The region ID. You can go to <props="china">service registration endpoints (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/en/hologres/developer-reference/api-hologram-2022-06-01-endpoint)</props>
<props="intl">service registration endpoints (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/hologres/developer-reference/api-hologram-2022-06-01-endpoint)</props> to view the supported regions
parameters.help_zh:
地域Id. 可前往<props="china">服务接入点 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/hologres/developer-reference/api-hologram-2022-06-01-endpoint)</props>
<props="intl">服务接入点 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/hologres/developer-reference/api-hologram-2022-06-01-endpoint)</props>
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. If this parameter is left empty, the default resource group of the account is used
parameters.help_zh: 资源组。若为空，则为账号默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The standard storage capacity of the instance. Unit: GB.
This parameter is ignored for pay-as-you-go instances
parameters.help_zh:
实例标准存储空间。单位：GB。
按量付费实例（PostPaid）会忽略此参数
parameters.name: storage_size

parameters.help_en: The storage type
parameters.help_zh: 存储类型
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch. The zone ID of the vSwitch must be the same as that of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟专有交换机，其所在zoneId必须与实例一致
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC). The region ID of the VPC must be the same as that of the instance
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟专有网络，其所在regionId必须与实例一致
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID. Refer to the usage notes
parameters.help_zh: 可用区Id。参考“使用说明“
parameters.name: zone_id

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance was created. Valid values:  
true: The instance was created.
false: The instance failed to be created
Success.description_zh:
创建是否成功。  
true：创建成功。
false：创建失败
